hero.title: Customizable Desktop & Web solutions for Your Clinic
hero.subtitle: Every clinic is unique. We listen to your needs first, then build a tailored desktop application and web platform that perfectly fits your workflow — from appointment scheduling to patient management.

features.title: Everything You Need
features.subtitle: Every module adapts to your needs — tell us what you require and we will build it.

patients.title: Patient Management
patients.desc: Complete patient records with search, filters, allergies, treatment history and detailed patient cards.

odontogram.title: Interactive Odontogram
odontogram.desc: Visual tooth chart supporting surfaces, bridges, prosthetics, extractions and impacted teeth.

calendar.title: Appointment Calendar
calendar.desc: Weekly calendar with drag-and-drop appointments, multi-slot booking and automatic email confirmations.

booking.title: Online Booking
booking.desc: Web wizard lets patients self-book appointments by service category, choosing their doctor and preferred time.

sync.title: Cloud Sync
sync.desc: Real-time sync between desktop and web apps with offline support and automatic retry.

email.title: Email Notifications
email.desc: Automatic appointment confirmations, birthday greetings, holiday messages and customizable email templates.

treatments.title: Treatment Records
treatments.desc: Multi-service treatments with notes, initial assessments, per-tooth history and completion status tracking.

security.title: Security & Logging
security.desc: Data encryption, rate limiting, CORS policies and security headers for maximum protection of user information.

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Detailed reports on revenue, patient count, treatments by doctor and period — all statistics in one place for better business insights.

admin.title: Administration
admin.desc: Full control over clinic settings — doctor schedules, working hours, service categories, pricing and user roles tailored to your needs.

appointments.title: Online Appointment Acceptance
appointments.desc: Receive and manage online bookings directly from the desktop or mobile app — approve, decline or reschedule appointments in just a few clicks.

documents.title: Patient Documents
documents.desc: All patient documents in one place — tooth images, X-rays, PDF reports, referrals and other treatment-related documentation.

desktop.title: Desktop Application
desktop.subtitle: A customizable desktop application built around your requirements — from the interface to functionality, everything adapts to your workflow.

feature1.title: Patient Cards
feature1.desc: Detailed view of each patient with tabs for appointments, treatments, odontogram, notes and correspondence.

feature2.title: Doctor Management
feature2.desc: Doctor work schedules, calendar colors, active/inactive status and automatic treatment assignment.

feature3.title: Service Administration
feature3.desc: Service categories with colors, pricing, duration and support for special odontogram shapes.

feature4.title: Offline Mode
feature4.desc: Application works without internet — data syncs automatically when connection is re-established.

web.title: Web Application
web.subtitle: A web application designed to your specification — you define the features and we implement them with modern technologies.

feature1.title: Booking Wizard
feature1.desc: Intuitive step-by-step process: choose category, service, doctor, date and time — all in a few clicks.

feature2.title: Services Page
feature2.desc: Browse all services by category with detailed descriptions, pricing and direct booking option.

feature3.title: Responsive Design
feature3.desc: Optimized layout for all devices — desktop, tablet and mobile with a consistent user experience.

feature4.title: Contact Form
feature4.desc: Direct clinic communication through contact form with email notifications and validation.

privacy.title: Data Protection

Personal data is collected voluntarily and used for consultations, advertising and marketing only with explicit consent. Please note that this website does not store your data in digital form on web servers.

You can disable cookies in your browser settings. This website uses cookies exclusively for anonymous statistical processing and improving user experience.
privacy.cookies_p2: Our website uses Google Analytics to analyze website visits. Google Analytics uses cookies that are transferred to and stored on Google servers. Google may use this data to evaluate website usage. Google will not associate your IP address with other data held by Google. You can prevent cookie installation by selecting appropriate browser settings. However, please note that in this case you may not be able to use all features of this website to their full extent. By using this website, you consent to the processing of data collected by Google in the manner and for the purpose described.
